policy.purpose: First-party Mercedes backend semantic vocabulary for offline MBLINK research
policy.diagnostic_identity_rule: Backend keys are not UDS DIDs or ECU addresses
policy.automatic_polling_rule: Semantic catalogue entries never enter live polling by themselves
policy.scope: Mercedes-wide semantic catalogue; no chassis-specific assumption
policy.applicability_rule: Presence in MBSDK does not prove support on every Mercedes model or model year
